How we work

  1. Visit or video call

    You show us the space and tell us how you want to use it.

  2. Plan

    We draw the layout and the planting.

  3. Quote

    Scope, price and timing in writing.

  4. Build

    We do the works, or guide your local team.

  5. Care

    A calendar and visits or check-ins as agreed.

The garden year

Indicative: your local climate has the last word.

Hemisphere

    Tropical climates: follow the wet and dry seasons instead. Plant as the rains begin and watch drainage.

    Water, wisely

    We group plants by how much water they need and choose drip irrigation where it makes sense. Local watering restrictions come first.

    Before planting

    Children and pets

    Some common garden plants are toxic. Tell us who uses the garden before we choose.

    Permits

    Felling trees, heavy pruning or building may need a local permit. Check before work starts.

    The right plant

    We choose for your climate and avoid species that are invasive where you live.

    Questions

    Can you design a garden in another country?

    Yes, remotely: you send measurements and photos once we have spoken, and we work by video call.

    Do you build remote projects?

    Your local team builds them. We provide the plan and answer questions.

    I only have a balcony.

    That works too. Tell us the size, the sun and any weight limits set by your building.

    Which units do you use?

    Metric or imperial, as you prefer.

    Show us your space

    Tell us what you have and what you would like.
